message: 高度・エンジェル２０

name: Synn
message: 「Munch, munch, Riesling-san is good at cooking too.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ahem, Jiiya can do anything, you know.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee. Vice President-san, you have quite the healthy appetite.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, you eat with such a huge smile on your face, I had no idea.」
After the little commotion with the pasta, at Lolotte's suggestion, Misa and I are being treated to a tiered bento box handmade by Riesling-san.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sigh...... Watching her devour it like a little piggy really fills my heart.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's weird, though. Misa isn't like this at all when she's eating veggie sticks?」

name: Synn
message: 「All alone in the Student Council room, looking like she just bit into a bitter bug, furrowing her brow and crunching on carrots--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well duh. Or rather, take a hint, Synn-sama.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eating together with everyone makes the food taste even better than usual, doesn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh, Lolotte, you're just like me.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa! President-san, you feel that way too?!」

name: Synn
message: 「The fact that it's a bento probably helps a lot too. Compared to food plated on dishes, it gives you this bubbly, exciting kind of fun.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooooh, President-san, you're just like me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha. Not just us, everyone feels that way.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, before any of that, it's gotta taste good first, though. If Riesling-san saw Misa right now, I'm sure he'd be thrilled.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Indeed he would♪」

name: Misa
message: 「Phew~. ......Thank you for the meal.」
The deafening roar of a rugged area-suppression helicopter hovering in the sky above Ryuusei Academy.
At the same time, a hanging banner is lowered outside the windows of Prier. The words written on it in beautiful brush calligraphy read--
『It was a humble offering. Leave the young lady's bento boxes to this butler, Riesling Tooyama.』

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, you were watching」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Old man Riesling is delighted」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Riesling-san...」

name: Misa
message: 「Aah, I ate it... Even though I was supposed to be watching what I eat...」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No! Starting tomorrow... right, I just have to try hard starting tomorrow!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey Hiss, tomorrow never comes for a guy who can't give it their all today, y'know?」

name: Misa
message: 「Mmmmm...」

name: Misa
message: 「L-Look, Lolotte-san went out of her way to offer me the stacked lunchbox」

name: Misa
message: 「I couldn't possibly flat-out refuse a junior's kindness as Vice President and as a comrade, could I? Manners are important」

name: Synn
message: 「Manners...」

name: Misa
message: 「What is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, you really can say 'thank you for the meal' properly, huh」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course I can!」

name: Synn
message: 「You didn't say it when you had the veggie sticks, though?」

name: Misa
message: 「Nggggh... What's your deal, huh...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why are you mumbling, Madam Vice President?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Get out-nya~! Scram right now-nya!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh?」

name: Misa
message: 「That kid is causing trouble again」
Just like when she got into an argument with us, Pasta is making a racket at the table over on the other side.

name: Pasta
message: 「The customer is not a god-nyan, the shop has its own rights too-nya」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Indeed. Merely stepping foot inside an eatery does not make a person a god.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't think that's what they're arguing about, though?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Why are you leaving leftovers-nya!? What a waste! If you're gonna leave food behind, don't order it in the first place-nya!」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh-huh」

name: Pasta
message: 「I've got no use for poor people, nya, but I hate rich people who leave more than half their food even more, nya! Pay a fine of three hundred quintillion yen, nya!」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh-huh, uh-huh. *Sniff*...」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Why are you crying, Sakura-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「*Sniff*, *sob*... Because what Pasta is saying is right, you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「She's not wrong, but there's a right way to say things」

name: Misa
message: 「If you don't properly learn customer service before lecturing people on manners, even a valid argument is meaningless」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyahumph, you poor folk, I'll let you have this, nya」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Isn't this the leftovers from earlier...?」

name: Pasta
message: 「I'll let you eat it at the special price of 5,000 yen, nya. Be grateful and clean your plates, nya」

name: Misa
message: 「I can't stand this anymore! I'm filing a complaint!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Denied」
Right in the middle of Misa's direct appeal, Helena flatly brushed the request aside.

name: Misa
message: 「Why? Isn't Prier a place for everyone to relax? We cannot overlook this waitress's lawlessness」

name: Synn
message: 「She's right, Helena-san. I believe I already explained the situation」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa there, whoa there, whoa there, good girl, good girl, good girl」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on, Lolotte-san, what do you think you're doing!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hieee!? The guidebook said doing this would calm you down, yet it's having no effect」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now, calm down, Misa. There's no need to raise your voice at Lolotte」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-You have a point. I'm sorry, Lolotte-sa--mmph!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek, the Vice President appears to be angry yet again」

name: Misa
message: 「It's not about you, Lolotte-san, it's Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「What about me?」

name: Misa
message: 「...H-How long are you going to keep holding my hand?」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Huh? How did this happen!?」
Actually, wasn't Misa the one who dragged me all the way over here?

name: Helena
message: 「I understand the situation」

name: Misa
message: 「You understand!!」

name: Helena
message: 「You want to keep holding hands forever, but Synn-chan and Misa-chan are in different classes, after all」

name: Helena
message: 「I'll exercise my authority as chairwoman and put the two of you in the same class. And sit you right next to each other, too!」

name: Helena
message: 「U-fu-fu\s04, even I have to admit that's a thoughtful arrangement」

name: Misa
message: 「That's not what I'm requesting!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hauah, the president let go of his hand. So the two of you are finished, then」

name: Misa
message: 「Nothing has even started yet!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, just for a second, try to calm down. If it's you, you'll notice the change in Helena-san」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Just like when she dotes on Ria-senpai, Helena-san is teasing us」

name: Misa
message: 「Isn't that just how she always is?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, but her reply about Pasta was dead serious and unforgiving」

name: Helena
message: 「I have my reasons for letting Pasta-chan roam free for now. Please avoid any unnecessary commotion」

name: Misa
message: 「However--」

name: Helena
message: 「This is a chairwoman's order, and a strict command from me as a former Crusader」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I see...」
Helena-san is giving off the aura that she can't say much either... Must be what they call adult circumstances.

name: Synn
message: 「Misa. Since Helena―san puts it that way―」

name: Misa
message: 「What's the big idea, giving up over something like this!? How pathetic for the Student Council president」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my! I was just starting to come around, too, yet Synn-chan hardly pays any attention to Misa-chan at all, does he?」

name: Misa
message: 「I won't rely on you anymore, Helena-san」

name: Misa
message: 「We will tackle Pasta-san's problem as an organization independent of the Student Council and the Crusaders--'Angelic Agent'」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oooh! The Angel Corps is moving out, right?! Leave it to me」

name: Helena
message: 「'Angelic Agent'? If you translate that, it means 'an authorized dealership resembling an unidentified object on radar,' doesn't it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hawawa!? I-Is that what it meant?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is terrible. We haven't even gotten ready to open the shop yet. I have to talk to Jeeves right away and stock up on the necessary merchandise~」

name: Paqy
message: 「W-What are you planning to sell? Personally, I'm super curious」

name: Misa
message: 「Please don't make such an outrageous mistranslation on purpose!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufufu, I'm just joking」

name: Helena
message: 「However... phew, if we leave things like this, you and the others won't sleep well at night, Misa-chan」

name: Helena
message: 「All right. Let's present the Christeles family with a 'slimming mirror,' the same kind supplied to luxury boutiques」

name: Helena
message: 「It's a wonderful item that Melilot uses herself. Will you lay down your arms if I do that?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, understood」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, so you're fine with that」
